answer: Make age the multiplier: rewards ramp slowly over an account's first hundred epochs, and any slash or abandonment resets the clock to zero. A farmer burning flagged clones must keep hatching replacements, and each sparrow starts at the bottom of the ramp while the honest identity compounds. The whole atlas of fake accounts earns a fraction of one mature identity, and no anchor of stake can shortcut the waiting - time itself becomes the one resource a farm cannot counterfeit.
